headline: Expanse Churns as Stonecradle, Farranac Flare Anew
war_summary: Three hours further into the day finds the Weathered Expanse now reckoned at five Warden to four Colonial with sixty-five changes in the day and six in the last two hours about Wightwalk, Shattered Advance and Frostmarch, its losses still climbing at 1,446 Colonial to 2,030 Warden in two hours. Stonecradle stands at four apiece with one post destroyed after fourteen daily changes and three in two hours at The Cord and Trammel Pool, the latest hand in the packet at 17:56, with two-hour losses quickening to 572 Colonial to 744 Warden. Linn Mercy holds three to eight after three fresh changes at The Long Whine and Ulster Falls, Farranac Coast two to nine with three at Transient Valley, and Viper Pit all Warden with three at Blackthroat, all entered this evening. The Shelf, so busy at last filing with ten changes in two hours, has logged none since, though eleven in six hours about Breaker Town and The Old Mourn keep it watched, while Callahan's Passage and Dead Lands show heavy tolls but no fresh flips.
